scripts.text:
[Guide]
Hello~
This guide wants to be the one to take you to a special place.
What kind of place is that?
scripts.translation:
[向导]
你好~
这位向导想带你去一个特别的地方。
那是什么样的地方呢？

scripts.text:
[Guide]
It's a place full of mysterious items to collect and sell.
To buy stuff there you need special money.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
那里充满了神秘物品，可以收集也可以出售。
在那里买东西需要特殊的货币。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
So, are you ready to go there?
scripts.translation:
[向导]
那么，你准备好去了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Okay~
But don't get frustrated.
There's always more chances~
scripts.translation:
[向导]
好的~
不过别灰心。
机会总是有的~

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Yeah~ You're really ready.
Well then, get some good stuff~
Oops, I forgot. When you come out be sure to come back here.
Rember this~
scripts.translation:
[向导]
嗯~ 你真的准备好了。
那么，去挑选好东西吧~
哎呀，我忘了。出来的时候记得回来这里。
记住这一点~

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Have you had a good time?
Thank you very much for using our item mall.
We will continue to bring you valuable items.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
你玩得开心吗？
非常感谢你使用我们的物品商城。
我们会继续为你带来珍贵的物品。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Would you like to return from where you came from?
scripts.translation:
[向导]
你想回到你来的地方吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Guide]
There are still more things to see.
Have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
还有更多东西可以看。
祝你玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Thank you for coming.
I'll send you back from where you came from.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
谢谢你的光临。
我会把你送回你来的地方。

scripts.text:
[Macaroon]
Welcome!
Today doesn't come every day!
Things to see today~ Voila!
You can only exchange with {0}!
Feel free to choose!
scripts.translation:
[马卡龙]
欢迎光临！
今天可不是天天都有哦！
今天可以看到的~ 看这里！
只能用{0}兑换哦！
请随意挑选！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Basta]
I have taken over the work of Mighty Hammer, Brock and the Shadow Blacksmith. I will be busy from now on.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 巴斯塔]
我接手了巨力铁锤、布罗克和影子铁匠的工作。从现在开始我会很忙的。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
If it is about refining, ask Basta. I am retired.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 巨力铁锤]
如果是关于精炼的事，请去问巴斯塔。我已经退休了。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Brock]
I am retired now. If it is about refining, make a request to Basta over there.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 布罗克]
我现在退休了。如果是关于精炼的事，请去那边找巴斯塔。

scripts.text:
[Jeremy]
Hello cutie~
I would like you to call me Head Stylist Jeremy.
scripts.translation:
[杰瑞米]
你好呀，小可爱~
请叫我首席造型师杰瑞米。

scripts.text: Change style
scripts.translation: 改变造型

scripts.text: End conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Jeremy]
My shop is always open, so please come back anytime.
scripts.translation:
[杰瑞米]
我的店随时都开着，欢迎随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Stylist]
Hey, I'm Kaniki.
I'm here to start a new
trend by introducing my
special new hairstyles!
Give me a ^FF0000New Style Coupon^000000,
and I'll change your hair~
scripts.translation:
[造型师]
嘿，我是卡尼基。
我要通过介绍我特别的新发型来引领新潮流！
给我一张^FF0000新造型券^000000，
我就帮你换发型~

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
I have two special
hairstyles for men, the
Emergency Heal Perm
and the Aura Blade Cut.
and aura blade cut.
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
我有两款男士特别发型，
分别是紧急治愈烫和灵气剑切。
还有灵气剑切。

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
This is the Emergency
Heal Perm. It's a brand
new style I invented recently.
What do you think? Cool, huh?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
这是紧急治愈烫。这是我最近发明的一款全新发型。
你觉得怎么样？很酷吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
Now this is the Aura
Blade Cut. You haven't
seen anything like it
before, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
这是灵气剑切。你以前肯定没见过这种发型，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
I have two new hairstyles for
women, the Assumptio Perm
and the Soul Changer Cut.
Do you want to see how
these styles look?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
我有两款女士新发型，
分别是圣母之祈福烫和灵魂变换切。
你想看看这些发型的效果吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
This is the Assumptio
Perm. It'd really good
on you, wouldn't it?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
这是圣母之祈福烫。你留这个发型一定很好看，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
Next is the Soul
Changer Cut. What do
you think? Isn't it nice?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
接下来是灵魂变换切。你觉得怎么样？很不错吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
Have you decided
if you'd like me to
change your hairstyle?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
你决定好要不要让我帮你换发型了吗？

scripts.text: Change Hairstyle
scripts.translation: 更换发型

scripts.text: Don't Change
scripts.translation: 不更换

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
Really? Oh, that's too bad.
Well, if you ever change your
mind about updating your
hairstyle, come back
and let me know, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
真的吗？哎呀，那太遗憾了。
如果您之后改变主意，想更新发型的话，
记得回来告诉我哦。

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
I'm sorry, but I can
only provide my hairstyling
service if you bring a New
Style Coupon. Please come
back to me after you manage to
get one of those coupons, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
很抱歉，只有持有“新发型券”才能使用我的美发服务。
请您拿到那种券后再来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
Great, you brought
a New Style Coupon!
Alright, which hairstyle
did you want to have?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
太好了，您带来了新发型券！
那么，您想换成哪种发型呢？

scripts.text: Emergency Heal Perm
scripts.translation: 紧急治愈烫

scripts.text: Aura Blade Cut
scripts.translation: 灵气剑剪

scripts.text: Assumptio Perm
scripts.translation: 圣母之祈福烫

scripts.text: Soul Changer Cut
scripts.translation: 灵魂变换剪

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
There--! It's done!
How do you like your
new hair? Well, I hope
to see you again. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
好了——！完成了！
您觉得新发型怎么样？
希望下次还能为您服务。再见！
